capabilities: Handwrite on PDF pages with pressure-sensitive ink
Erase ink with a boolean eraser in partial or whole-stroke modes
Select, transform, copy, cut and paste ink strokes
Draw lines, arrows, rectangles and ellipses with automatic shape recognition
Organize ink on document layers and switch a tab back to a plain reader
extras: Early preview (0.1.4) with rough edges; tested only on desktop Windows with a pen tablet; README asks users to back up the annotation folder before relying on it; no network requests or telemetry; bilingual English/Chinese UI; MIT licensed.
motivation: The author could not find a mainstream PDF annotation plugin for Obsidian, so decided to make one with as many features as possible and handwriting performance close to a dedicated notes app.
problem: Obsidian has no mainstream plugin for writing on and annotating PDF pages by hand, so PDFs stay read-only inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Development follows the feature set of Xiangzuo Notes (享做笔记)

summary: Handwriting and annotation layer for PDF pages, with pressure-sensitive ink, layers, shapes and a boolean eraser, stored in sidecar JSON.
